lead: A private `const` that falls out of scope becomes a binding pattern, not an error.
body: `TY_XML` in a `match` arm is a new variable once the module that holds it is a sibling, so the arm matches everything after it; only a multi-pattern arm gets an `E0408` naming it, and an arm of its own compiles and matches every column type. `pub(super)` on the consts before the first build is the cheap order; reading the first build's errors is the other one.
